lead: Sukumar is an Indian film director, born on 10 January 1971 in Kakinada.
As of 2026, he is 55 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He has 16 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Nandi Award for Best Screenplay Writer and Filmfare Award for Best Director – Telugu.
